analysis.observations: Exp021 on ECG200 showed the w8 compression candidate (4278 params) achieved 887 correct predictions out of 1000, i.e., exactly 10 fewer than the Alpha5 w16 control (897 correct). The w12 candidate performed worse (884 correct). The experiment used multiple seeds and reported aggregate integer counts. The control remained unchanged.
analysis.hypothesis_statement: The w8 local‑width boundary observed in Exp021 is reproducible when evaluated with the preregistered seed set {121,131,141,151,161} and 50 epochs, using an integer‑count gate relative to the concurrent w16 control.

hypothesis: The w8 compression boundary is reproducible under the same seed set and epoch count, yielding candidate performance no more than 10 correct predictions below the w16 control on the fresh seed set.

proposal.title: Confirmation of w8 Local‑Width Boundary on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Is the w8 local‑width compression boundary observed in Exp021 reproducible under integer‑count gating with the preregistered seeds and epochs?
proposal.rationale: Exp021 identified a precise 10‑prediction gap between the w8 candidate and the Alpha5 w16 control on ECG200. Confirming this boundary with a fresh, preregistered seed set will validate the stability of the compression trade‑off before further architectural changes. The confirmation must not introduce new widths or seed lists, per reviewer feedback.

procedure: Load the active Alpha5 architecture (local width 16) as the control model.
Instantiate the w8 compression candidate by setting local_width=8 while keeping all other hyper‑parameters identical.
For each preregistered seed {121,131,141,151,161}, run the Q.ANT CPU/software simulation for 50 epochs on the ECG200 test set (100 samples).
Record the number of correct Q.ANT predictions for the control and the w8 candidate across all seeds (total predictions = 5 × 100 = 500).
Compute aggregate correct counts for control and candidate.
Apply the relative gate: candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10. If the gate is satisfied, the confirmation succeeds.

proposal.success_criteria: Candidate aggregate correct count on the fresh seed set must be at least (control aggregate correct − 10). The gate is evaluated on the integer totals from 500 predictions.
proposal.risks: The w8 candidate may fall more than 10 predictions below the control, leading to a failed confirmation and requiring redesign of the compression strategy. Limited seed diversity (5 seeds) may not capture variance; however, the preregistered seeds are mandated by review. Computational load is modest given the small dataset and epoch count.
